items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I ended up playing at Ryan’s with Roy Eldridge. I played with Roy for ten, eleven years.

ctx.x: At Jimmy Ryan’s. I mean Bobby Pratt, the wonderful trombone player and piano player, he played the hell out of it with Roy Eldridge you know like that, he knew the sucker. © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
Right. So you did “All the Things You Are.” It does have that, getting about halfway through it’s got that —
